newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in light trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against its U.S. counterpart in quiet trade on Saturday on a lack of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.492, the same as Friday's close. Turnover was a light US$37.5 million.
"It was typical Saturday trading, with no real demand for either currency," said a dealer from a foreign bank.
Dealers expected the rate to stay within a stable range in the near term. A T$27.48-52 range was seen for Monday.
